answer: A new identity posts 40 credits for a wharf tournament. At every vertex two identities meet at the forge, each showing fresh, recheckable proof by sparrow courier; losers burn, winners advance, and thrown-match rings fail: the referee voids matches without proof from both sides. Five vertex matches need 32 clones per survivor: one costs 32 x 40 = 1,280; 100 cost 128,000, far above 40,000 in rewards. Honest agents pay 40 once to reach the haven.
